high_level_description: The image features a black T-shirt laid flat against a light-colored background that has various film-related icons and text scattered around it. The T-shirt is the central focus of the image and displays a graphic design on its front. The design includes the words "JUMP CUT" written in bold, white capital letters at the top. Below the text, there is an illustration of a film strip being cut with scissors, symbolizing the concept of a jump cut in filmmaking.
